title: Schedule a meeting without a long positional argument list
task: In package `calendar` I need to schedule a meeting from a title, a start time, a duration, a room name, an organizer email, and a list of attendee emails, and get back a `Meeting` that can report whether it `Overlaps` another meeting. A meeting needs at least one attendee and a positive duration, otherwise it is an error. Design the API so a call site reads naturally rather than as a long positional list. Test overlap on touching, disjoint, and nested intervals.
